description: Benjamin Cowen crypto framework — market cycle awareness, 21-week EMA as bull/bear divider, risk-off when indicators say so, BTC dominance rotation
applies_to: CRYPTO ONLY — this strategy is for crypto trades, not stocks

core_concepts.1_bare_market_resistance_band: The 20-week SMA and 21-week EMA form a resistance band. In bear markets, price gets rejected here. In bull markets, it acts as support. Check where BTC is relative to this band before trading ANY crypto.
core_concepts.2_btc_dominance: BTC dominance rising = risk rolling DOWN the curve (altcoins bleed to BTC, BTC bleeds to stocks, stocks bleed to gold). When dominance rising, only trade BTC, not altcoins.
core_concepts.3_midterm_year_psychology: Midterm years eat portfolios alive. Counter-trend rallies trick people into buying back in, then lower lows follow. Don't FOMO into rallies.
core_concepts.4_windows_of_weakness: Historical weakness months: February, April, June, August, October. Be cautious entering new crypto positions during these windows.
core_concepts.5_always_bull_market_somewhere: If crypto is in a bear phase, look elsewhere (energy, metals, stocks). Don't force crypto trades in a bear cycle.

entry_rules.1_check_btc_vs_21week_ema: Before ANY crypto trade, check if BTC is above or below the 21-week EMA. Above = bullish environment, trade freely. Below = bear market, reduce size or skip.
entry_rules.2_btc_dominance_direction: If BTC dominance rising on weekly chart, ONLY trade BTC. Avoid altcoins — they will underperform.
entry_rules.3_counter_trend_awareness: If BTC is in a bear market (below 21w EMA) and rallying, treat it as a COUNTER-TREND rally. Tighter stops, smaller size, expect rejection at the 21w EMA.
entry_rules.4_support_at_prior_cycle_levels: Key BTC levels from prior cycles tend to act as support/resistance. Check if current price is near a historically significant level.
entry_rules.5_rsi_divergence: If price making higher highs but RSI making lower highs on daily = bearish divergence. Don't enter longs.

exit_rules.1_rejection_at_21w_ema: If BTC gets rejected at the 21-week EMA (bear market resistance band), close longs immediately.
exit_rules.2_btc_dominance_reversal: If BTC dominance starts dropping on weekly, consider rotating some BTC to altcoins.
exit_rules.3_seasonality_exit: Before known weakness windows (June, October), reduce crypto exposure.

how_to_check.21_week_ema: On TradingView, switch BTCUSD to Weekly timeframe, add EMA(21). If price is above = bull. Below = bear.
how_to_check.btc_dominance: Chart BTC.D on TradingView. Rising = risk-off for altcoins.
how_to_check.rsi_divergence: RSI(14) on Daily chart. Compare RSI highs vs price highs.

key_difference_from_v80: v8.0 and v8.1 treat crypto like stocks — just find movers and trade momentum. v8.2 adds MACRO CONTEXT: is the crypto market in a bull or bear cycle? Should we even be trading crypto right now, or should we wait? Cowen's framework prevents trading against the macro trend.
